title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 5 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: There is a park near my home.
There is a playground in the park.
Where is the library? It's over there.
The hospital is next to the shop.
Is there a bus stop near here?
My favourite place is the library.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的地方是图书馆。
